what: A vertical card like a player card tilts in 3D following the pointer — rotating the X axis by (r−.5)×−30° from the horizontal ratio inside the card and the Y axis by (r−.5)×100° from the vertical ratio, clamped at ±30°, and pulled 5% toward the opposite side (.1s while following, .4s on release). On top, a white glow pool (overlay) sits at the pointer, and a rainbow·metal band (color-dodge·hard-light) slides within a 28% ratio range — a trading card hologram

options.tx: Aspect ratio → X-axis rotation multiplier, default −30
options.ty: Vertical ratio → Y-axis rotation multiplier, default 100
options.spread: Range the band and light spot move (%), default 28
options.look: plain: Only tilt and pools of light, no rainbow band
options.[data-fx-part=glare] · [data-fx-part=foi: (if present) Light pool and rainbow band layers — if absent, they are created and appended at the end of the card
options.--fx-rx · --fx-ry · --fx-mx · --fx-my ·: Variables a part attaches to the card — the using side’s css may also write them on other layers (name tag float-up etc.)

note: The original’s sparkle texture is a single outside image, so it is replaced with our SVG noise (fractalNoise). The original css has several overlapping rules for the same selector, so the values actually applied (later rules overriding earlier ones) were ported

from.where: index.html .ys-card (player card row). Original script.js card formula (rX (rx−.5)×−30 · rY (ry−.5)×100 · ±30 · pos 50+(r−.5)×28 · hyp ×10/7), common.css .card-wrapper:hover. > .highlight·.color(::after)
about.html .av-value — value cards (look: plain · max 12 · tx -20 · ty 20, the rainbow is layered on at .25 by the card css)
